types.name: UGroup

fields.name: tag
fields.comment: high: GroupLocateTag 117950 / DataLocateTag 117b50 compare [+0x0] with the tag; DataCountType 1179f0 masks it with 0xffff2020|0x2020 when flags bit 0 is set (indexed tags 'cn'+n, 'sr'+n)

fields.name: flags
fields.comment: high: GetArray 117940: bit 1 = +0xc relative; groups: flags>>5 = child group count (GroupLocateTag, ProcessBreadthFirst 117c10), bit 3 = data sorted (DataLocateTag binary search FUN_117840), bit 4 = groups sorted; ResolveOffsets 117cb0 clears bit 1.

fields.name: dataCount
fields.comment: high: groups: number of data entries after the child groups (DataLocateTag bound ((flags>>5)+[+8])*0x10); data entries: element count or index (WCollisionMgr::Init c55b0 takes the 'ci' count from +8; WGrid::Init c5fc0 uses 'cn' +8 as the node index)

fields.name: offset
fields.comment: high: groups: array offset in 16-byte units from this entry when bit 1 (GetArray: this + [+0xc]*0x10); data: byte offset from the entry (Init c55b0: [+0xc] + entry when [+4]&2); becomes an absolute pointer after ResolveOffsets

types.comment: One 16-byte entry of the serialised EAGL tree (.crp files are one UGroup tree loaded in place). Data entries (UData) share the layout: +0x4 bits 8.. = byte size, bit 0 = tag carries an index in its low 16 bits, +0xc = byte offset. Child groups precede data entries in the array.
